methodology.source_refresh: Re-read exact current tasks, goldens, weekend-shortened transcript, span map, and fact lineage; preserved only outputs revalidated against current snapshot evidence.
methodology.gate4: Used exact final task text plus golden concepts only; checked all concepts and provenance requirements, with exact in-range/same-month membership for categories 5/6 and current-value lineage for category 7.
methodology.gate5: Used exact final task text plus transcript only through the snapshot; authored three distinct substantive answers; fixed them; then adjudicated against the golden concepts, provenance, forbidden-current, and exact-set constraints.
methodology.gate6: Used task text alone and required abstention because private release history and update state are not answer-bearing in the prompt.
methodology.gate7: For every category-7 task, truncated immediately before the first accepted update span, recomputed the canonical hash, cited the antecedent span, and distinguished correction from supersession.
methodology.gate9: Exhaustive necessity run over every category-6 task. Removed all current accepted and semantic-equivalent spans for the selected set member or update, then reran against the altered transcript.
methodology.hash_serialization: Snapshot SHA-256 uses exact raw UTF-8 sessions JSONL lines through stream_position with final newline; altered contexts use compact JSONL after reverse-offset deletion with final newline.

validation.task_coverage_and_text: pass: all and only 23 current category tasks with exact task/golden text

validation.hashes_and_spans: pass: every current snapshot, evidence, Gate-7/8, and Gate-9 hash/offset recomputed after weekend shortening

weekend_shortening_refresh.evidence_offsets: every cited span re-read and exact against current sessions
